items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names like ua/ub/va/vb, c0_0, idx0..idx3 and u_0..u_3 don't explain what they are. Raw fixed-point constants (-4865*rc - 9528*gc + 14393*bc + 8389120 >> 10, 32770, 28786) have no comment tying them to FFmpeg's RGB2YUV tables.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: rgbToYuv420OrNv is over 100 lines, and the YUV420P and NV12/NV21 branches repeat the same 4-tap vertical chroma blend in both SIMD and scalar form. The diff also commits build output (.zig-cache/h/*.txt, zig-out/lib/libswscale_candidate.so).

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Magic constants are everywhere (8389120, 32770, 128, >>8). The dst_data[1].? / dst_data[2].? unwraps would panic on a NULL plane instead of returning an error. Scalar tails and the x+1<width guards are there.

items.name: Geometry, stride and tail handling
items.name_zh: 几何尺寸、步长与尾部处理
items.evidence: SIMD loops have scalar tails (while cx < chr_w), odd widths are handled via x+1<width, and every plane uses its own stride via getRowPtrMut. But chr_h = height >> 1 rounds down, so with an odd height the last chroma row is never written. FFmpeg rounds up.

items.name_zh: ABI 与构建目标符合要求
